title: Pure WAKE CUP!

allow.Book of Moon: Generic Quick-Play that turns a monster face-down; it only carries the "Book of" name, and resets Flip monsters for another FLIP.
allow.Book of Taiyou: Generic Spell that flips a face-down monster face-up; it only carries the "Book of" name, and triggers Earl's or Whirlwind Weasel's FLIP on your own turn.

summary: The four WAKE CUP! monsters with generic Flip monsters and staples; the page's 2026 build adds the Prediction Princess Ritual engine, which this list leaves out. WAKE CUP! Kuro, the newest card, is revealed from the hand to search any WIND Flip monster, and on the field its Quick Effect flips a face-down monster face-up on the opponent's turn, so the generic Flip locks go off when they hurt most: Whirlwind Weasel stops Spells and Traps, Sonic Jammer stops Spells into the next turn, and Guard Dog stops Special Summons. WAKE CUP! Earl (the page's "Erl") sends cards to the GY for each Flip monster you control. With only four WAKE CUP! cards, the Flip monsters, Book of Moon and Book of Taiyou make up the rest; the two Books are the only cards outside the archetype that are not staples.
main: WAKE CUP! Kuro
Newest card: reveals to search a WIND Flip monster; flips a face-down monster on either turn.
WAKE CUP! Earl
Discards a Flip monster to summon itself; FLIP sends their face-up cards to the GY.
WAKE CUP! Macchia
Reveals with another Flip monster to summon both face-down.
WAKE CUP! Mocha
Summons itself next to a face-down monster; turns face-down again each End Phase.
Whirlwind Weasel
WIND Flip lock: the opponent can't activate Spells or Traps that turn.
Sonic Jammer
WIND Flip lock: no Spells until the end of the next turn.
Mahjong Munia Maidens
WIND Flip loot that turns itself face-down again.
Guard Dog
EARTH Flip lock: no Special Summons that turn; not searchable by Kuro.
Book of Moon
Turns a monster face-down on either turn, including your own Flip monsters.
Book of Taiyou
Flips a face-down monster face-up on your turn.
